data.name: Duryodhan
data.gender_notes: Duryodhan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Hard to fight with; a Kaurava's name
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit dur, 'difficult', + yudh, 'to fight' — 'hard to fight with'. Its root is Sanskrit dur + yudh. Duryodhana, the eldest Kaurava in the Mahabharata. Duryodhan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Hard to fight with; a Kaurava's name”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Duryodhan expresses “Hard to fight with; a Kaurava's name”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit dur, 'difficult', + yudh, 'to fight' — 'hard to fight with'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Duryodhan total 47, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
